items.description: This is the Good News. GO OUT and tell everyone!! #spreadthegospel
What will happen when Jesus returns. Biblically
How we invite demons into our homes….
God on Halloween (Inspo: @Josh Benson ) (btw yes, it’s sarcasm)

Christians are held accountable to this. We are a family. We are His children. We are expected to share our blessings. Please prafully consider helping a family today  https://link.globalchristianrelief.org/ColinElliott Or there is a link in my bio

Christians in Nigeria are facing horrific violence for refusing to abandon the name of Jesus. Families are grieving, communities are being devastated, and believers are paying a price for their faith most of us can barely comprehend. This is why your donations matter and why becoming a monthly giver can make an even greater impact. LINK TO DONATE IN MY BIO. We cannot call them our brothers and sisters in Christ and then look away when they suffer. Skip one impulse buy. Sacrifice one convenience. Give once if that’s what you can do, but if God has given you the ability, stand with them month after month. “If one member suffers, all suffer together.” 1 Corinthians 12:26 SAVE A FAMILY TODAY! FOR JESUS: https://link.globalchristianrelief.org/ColinElliott @Global Christian Relief
Heavenly Father. Share to bless someone else today ♥️ let God cook
You needed this didn’t you? Share to 3 others and say nothing

Imagine gathering to worship Jesus knowing it could cost you your life. (LINK TO DONATE IN BIO) For many Christians in Nigeria, that isn’t a hypothetical. It’s reality. Families have been displaced. Churches have been attacked. Christians have been kidnapped and killed. And while much of the world scrolls past their suffering, our brothers and sisters are still crying out for help. We cannot say we are one body in Christ and then look away when part of that body is bleeding. “If one part suffers, every part suffers with it.” — 1 Corinthians 12:26 They need more than our attention. They need prayer. They need help. They need the Church to actually BE the Church. Maybe this week we skip the impulse buy. The extra coffee. The random Amazon order we’ll forget about in three days. What is disposable to us could be desperately needed by someone else. If God has blessed you with the ability to give, don’t just feel something. Do something. Every donation through Global Christian Relief helps support persecuted Christians who desperately need to know they have not been forgotten. They are our family. And our family is hurting. SAVE A FAMILY TODAY: https://link.globalchristianrelief.org/ColinElliott OR THERE IS A LINK IN MY BIO @Global Christian Relief
I know who won’t be in Heaven (jk)
If they made a Christian video game
